method.method_draft: First describe/read the image as a 3 by 3 grid whose corners are 1, 0, 4, and 3, whose center is 2, and whose four edge-center cells are blank. From the text, every one of the four possible 2 by 2 squares has sum 10, so the sum of all four 2 by 2 square sums is 4 · 10 = 40. Count how many times each cell is included in these four 2 by 2 squares: each corner is counted once, each edge-center blank is counted twice, and the center is counted four times. Let S be the sum of the four blanks. Then 40 = (1+0+4+3) + 2S + 4·2 = 8 + 2S + 8, so 2S = 24 and S = 12.
